svg.title: Pipeline rewrite and per-batch handoff
svg.desc: Only eligible sharded-module calls are rewritten; state stays attached to its batch. Solid bars: logical execution/access scopes; hollow dashed bars: unconsumed requests. Blue H2D, red D2H/host sync, purple AllToAll, amber request wait, green stream dependency. Trace eligible inputs; replace forward with a runtime wrapper start_sparse_data_dist(batch): create_context + input_dist Submit split-size AllToAll; compatible metadata requests may be fused by process group. Store module contexts and split requests Fuse compatible split metadata by process group wait_sparse_data_dist: first wait -> tensors requests First wait reads received CUDA split sizes on the host, then launches separate lengths and ID AllToAll payloads. The two variants below are alternatives for consuming this state, not consecutive stages. Ordinary sparse pipeline PipelinedForward pops tensors request + module context Second wait on data_dist stream; train stream joins Consumes payload and reconstructs the KJT; uncached, nonempty CUDA lengths in the fixed-stride path require D2H and current-stream synchronization. compute_and_output_dist(context, distributed input) Prefetch pipeline _prefetch: second wait -> module.prefetch -> post-prefetch state PrefetchPipelinedForward pops ready input + saved context Train stream joins prefetch stream compute_and_output_dist(context, distributed input)
